title: Fraternity of Samos: Structure and Entry Requirements
heading: Structure of the Fraternity of Samos
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Describes the Pythagorean cult's strict degree system and its unusual mundane Ability prerequisites for a first Initiation, which also add a bonus to the Initiation Script.
quotes: it is required that the prospective probationer can pass examinations in philosophiae and artes liberales, which can be represented by having attained a score of 3 in both those abilities
represented by a score of 1 in Music
confer a +1 bonus to the Initiation Script employed

title: Sample Initiation Script: Fraternity of Samos
heading: Sample Initiation Script for the Fraternity of Samos
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Worked example of an Initiation Script for the first Samos degree, showing how a special bonus, a season of teaching and a Minor Ordeal Vow add up to the script bonus.
quotes: Initiation Scripts with a bonus of +7 are very common
for a total Initiation Script bonus of +7

title: Samos Degree: Mathematicus
heading: Mathematicus
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: First Akousmatic degree; requires a minimum score in Artes Liberales (Mathematics) and teaches the Virtue Hermetic Numerology.
quotes: possessing at least a score of 3 in Artes Liberales (Mathematics)

title: Samos Degree: Theoreticus
heading: Theoreticus
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Second degree; requires a higher Artes Liberales (Geometry) score and a Numerologist's Book, and teaches the Virtue Hermetic Geometry.
quotes: possessing at least a score of 4 in Artes Liberales (Geometry)

title: Samos Degree: Electus
heading: Electus
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Third degree; teaches Planetary Magic. The Initiators keep a natal chart and a permanent Arcane Connection to the Initiate, giving casters against the Initiate a Penetration bonus; this counts as an Ordeal.
quotes: a bonus of eight times Penetration score when casting spells against the Initiate
constitutes an Ordeal for Initiation

title: Samos Inner Order: Mathematikoi
heading: The Inner Order: Mathematikoi
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Describes the Inner Order's duties: minimum Teaching, hosting visitors, and training apprentices, which can serve as a Sacrifice in later Initiation Scripts.
quotes: Members of the Mathematikoi must possess the mundane ability Teaching at a score of at least 2
conferring a +6 bonus for the 15 seasons sacrificed

title: Samos Degree: Tertius, or 3=4
heading: Tertius, or 3=4
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Fourth degree; teaches the geometry of the elemental solids and the Virtue Hermetic Architecture, with other Virtues rumored.
quotes: the Virtue Hermetic Architecture is now Initiated

title: Samos Degree: Secundus, or 2=5
heading: Secundus, or 2=5
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Fifth degree; rumored to teach Inscription on the Soul, Hermetic Theurgy or Theurgic Spirit Familiar.
quotes: It is rumored that some Initiates learn the mystery of the Virtue Inscription on the Soul

title: Samos Degree: Pythagorean, or True Initiate
heading: Pythagorean, or True Initiate
requires: Initiation: Fraternity of Samos
summary: Final degree; a five-year vow of silence counts as a Major Ordeal for Initiation Script purposes, and the Virtue taught is uncertain.
quotes: this counts as a Major Ordeal for Initiation Script purposes

title: Sample Initiation Script: Disciples of the Worm
heading: Example Initiation Script for the Disciples
requires: Initiation: Disciples of the Worm
summary: Worked example of the Spell Binding Initiation Script, itemizing season of work, tomb ordeal, teaching, offerings and sympathetic bonus.
quotes: a +9 Script is commonly employed to Initiate second degree disciples into the Mysteries of spell binding
for a total of +9

title: Disciples of the Worm: Structure and Seven Degrees
heading: Structure of The Disciples of the Worm
requires: Initiation: Disciples of the Worm
summary: Explains the cell organization of the cult and lists its seven degrees with the Virtue taught at each, from Second Sight to Living Ghost.
quotes: Initiates are divided into seven degrees

title: Sample Initiation Script: Knights of the Green Stone
heading: Example Initiation Script for the Green Stone
requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
summary: Worked example of the first Initiation of the Knights, with a Minor Ordeal that lowers the target level, a quest to the Castle, and a sacrifice for outfitting as a knight.
quotes: This Initiation Script confers a +7 bonus; it contains a Minor Ordeal that lowers the target level for this Initiation to 12
which creates the flaw Dutybound (+3)

title: Knights of the Green Stone: Structure and Degrees
heading: Structure of the Knights of the Green Stone
requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
summary: Describes the three degrees of the cult, the free Minor Status Virtue of knight role-playing, and the rules of membership.
quotes: The Knights divides its Initiates into three degrees, each of which offers up to three Initiations

title: Green Stone Degree: Page
heading: Page
requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
summary: First degree; Initiations into Free Expression, Performance Magic: Music and Puissant Art of Memory.
quotes: The third Virtue taught is Puissant Art of Memory

title: Green Stone Degree: Squire
heading: Squire
requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
summary: Second degree; may confer Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology and Consummate Talisman.
quotes: The Virtues Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology, and Consummate Talisman can be conferred at this degree.

title: Green Stone Degree: Knight
heading: Knight
requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
summary: Third degree; Virtues taught are Planetary Magic, a gemstone focus or Potent Magic, and Hermetic Synthemata.
quotes: They learn the Virtues Planetary Magic, Major Magical Focus: Gemstones or Potent Magic: Gemstones, and Hermetic Synthemata

title: Immortal Magi: General Rules
heading: Appendix A: Immortal Magi
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Common rules for magi who have become immortal beings of the Magic realm: Might, no Aging, Warping or Twilight, and a natural reversion to stasis that must be countered by binding changes into a talisman.
quotes: An immortal ceases to make Aging rolls — he truly does not age — and is beyond the effects of Warping and Twilight.
A being with a Might score is subject to Warding spells, including *Aegis of the Hearth*

title: Immortals: Permanent Change and the Talisman
heading: Immortal Beings and Permanent Change
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Explains how an immortal who keeps a talisman can bind learning into it, no longer limited in opening spaces by Technique and Form, and notes that Ordeals cannot be used for Initiation of immortals.
quotes: A maga who becomes immortal in one of these ways is no longer limited by her highest Technique and Form in the number of spaces she can open in her talisman
Ordeals cannot be used for Initiation of immortal beings

title: Immortals: Learning Arts or Abilities
heading: Learning Arts or Abilities
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Experience gained by an immortal fades over the next season unless a season is spent enchanting the talisman to bind it; includes a worked example.
quotes: The Effect level needed is 10 x XP to be retained.
She has a Creo Mentem lab total of 90, and can invest a level 45 effect in one season.

title: Binding the Immortal Memory (Enchantment)
heading: Binding the Immortal Memory
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Mystery enchantment guideline that binds a study period's experience into the talisman; the effect level required is tied to the experience points to retain and must be done in one season.
quotes: The Effect level needed is 10 x XP to be retained.
The effect must be completed in one season or all new experience points will be lost to the repair effect.

title: Immortal Familiars: Extra Vis for Transformation
heading: Becoming Immortal with a Familiar
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes) with a familiar
summary: A familiar can follow its magus into immortality if extra raw vis is added to the transformation rite; spirit familiars need none.
quotes: the magus must add extra raw vis to his transformation rite, equal to their Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up)

title: Immortals: Learning Spells
heading: Learning Spells
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: A spell learned by an immortal fades from memory over the season unless bound into the talisman by enchantment.
quotes: The magus can bind the knowledge of a spell by creating an enchantment in his talisman.

title: The Immortal's Grimoire (Enchantment)
heading: The Immortal's Grimoire
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Mystery enchantment guideline that lets the talisman hold the knowledge of a spell as an always-on memory, so the spell is cast normally with full Casting Total and Penetration.
quotes: The invested effect level must equal the level of spell to be retained.
by casting the spell normally the magus uses his full Casting Total, gets full Penetration (Casting Total – Spell level + Penetration Bonus), and has unlimited uses per day

title: Immortals: Binding High-Level Spells over Several Seasons
heading: Binding High-Level Spells
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Multi-season procedure alternating relearning a spell and investing it, with a Magic Theory roll to ensure the relearned spell matches and a botch table for failures.
quotes: He must succeed in a roll of Intelligence + Magic Theory against an Ease Factor of 6 + the magnitude of the spell.
To match each partial spell-binding, roll a stress die + Intelligence + Magic Theory vs. (6 + Magnitude of Spell).

title: Immortals: Unchanging Nature, Healing and Mental Changes
heading: Immortal and Unchanging
requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
summary: Sidebar giving how temporary changes, wounds and mental effects fade for immortals, with weekly Recovery rolls, thresholds by wound level, and a table matching spell levels to healing rates.
quotes: Any Temporary, Unbound Change will Fade Completely over a Season.
Recovery Total: Simple Die + Stamina + Medic's Chirurgy or Medicine Score + Magical Aid
Improve if Recovery Total is 10+ (Light Wounds), 12+ (Medium Wounds), 15+ (Heavy Wounds)

title: Converting Characters from Fourth Edition The Mysteries
heading: Appendix B: Conversion
requires: Converting a character from Fourth Edition The Mysteries
summary: Notes for converting Fourth Edition Mysteries characters: Abilities, Virtues and Flaws, Mastery, Mystae magics and the new Revised Edition schools.
quotes: Mastery Virtues are replaced by Mastery special abilities; see ArM5, page 87.
adding one Mastery Level for each Ability added

title: Daimons: General Rules, Aspects and Pacts
heading: Appendix C: Daimons
requires: Hermetic Theurgy (pacts with Daimons)
summary: Explains how Daimons act on Earth through Aspects, how they are Banished rather than killed, and how theurgists conjure them to provide powers and services.
quotes: A Daimon also does not respond in person — it sends an Aspect of its spirit.
binding or destroying an Aspect has no effect on the Daimon itself
Daimons are never killed or incapacitated by physical combat
